description: One corpus for the agent-worktree layout rule, read by both implementations of it: `agentLayout` in src/lib/work/agentWorktree.ts and `agent_layout` in src-tauri/src/engine/worktree.rs. The rule is duplicated on purpose — the backend labels worktrees inside a snapshot, and the Work view labels paths it already holds without a second IPC round trip — so this file is what stops the two copies drifting apart. An empty `kind` means the path is not an agent worktree; an empty `slug` on a matched path means the path names the container rather than a session.
rule: Split on runs of `/` and `\`, dropping empty segments. Windows and POSIX forms of the same path must agree.
Scan segments left to right for the first `.<kind>` immediately followed by a segment equal to `worktrees` (lowercase, exactly).

`<kind>` must be non-empty, must not begin with a dot (`.` and `..` are traversal, not directory names), and must not be `git` in any case — on the case-insensitive volumes macOS and Windows ship by default, `.GIT/worktrees` IS git's own metadata store.
The slug is the segment immediately after that `worktrees` segment, or empty when there is none. It is read from the same match that named the kind, never from a separate search.
